features.name: closed loop race circuit
features.notes: Lap circuit forming a continuous closed course
features.quote: Lap Circuit: A closed loop run a set number of times.

features.name: physical guardrails
features.notes: Along circuit boundaries as solid blocking walls or rails
features.quote: Physical Guardrail: Walls and rails that actually block the racer

features.name: painted track edge dividers
features.notes: Clearly mark the allowed corridor of movement
features.quote: Dividers explicitly marking the allowed corridor of movement

features.name: multi lane starting grid
features.notes: Wide launch area with evenly spaced side by side grid slots
features.quote: Multi-Lane Starting Grid: A wide launch front of evenly spaced slots

features.name: finish line
features.notes: Across the track at the course finish
features.quote: Terminal Finish: The built finish at the exact end of the course

features.name: race cars
features.quote: a 3d racing game where you race against the computer

excluded.name: computer controlled opponents
excluded.why: AI gameplay behavior not visually verifiable
